captions.home-canvas: Welcome to the Home screen: your distraction-free starting point where markets get decoded.
captions.home-header: At the top-left corner of the Header, clicking the λ icon always brings you right back to this main stage.
captions.home-markets: Centered at the top of the Header is Markets, your workstation to research all 213 global assets live.
captions.home-portfolio: Right beside it in the centered menu is Portfolio, to build allocations, stress-test risk, and simulate trades.
captions.home-system: Down in the bottom-left Footer, System opens the live observability monitor for servers and databases.
captions.home-guide: Beside it, Guide opens this interactive step-by-step manual whenever you need it.
captions.home-langs: At the bottom-right corner, the language button opens the centered modal to translate the platform into 56 languages.
captions.home-palettes: And Palette opens the 5 visual reading themes while keeping financial green and red strictly intact.
captions.scr-categories: In the top Categories bar, filter across All 213 assets, your Watchlist, or 10 specialized markets.
captions.scr-pulse: The 4 Pulse 24h cards show aggregated volume, average RSI, P-06 regime, and top volume dislocations.
captions.scr-table: The interactive Table features instant search, favorites, and smart columns tailored to each asset class.
captions.scr-orbital: The Orbital view maps assets across three concentric rings by deviation with a live side inspection panel.
captions.scr-heatmap: The Heatmap arranges the top 10 assets into proportional blocks across 8 shades of green and red.
captions.scr-maintools: And Main Tools guides you in three steps to sovereign curves, 3D volatility, FX cross, and futures engines.
captions.ana-hero: The Header combines the asset switcher, 9 timeframes from 1m to ALL, and the 5 core indicators.
captions.ana-technical: The Technical lens overlays SMA 20, VWAP, and 2σ Bollinger Bands with bottom volume confirmation.
captions.ana-compare: With Compare %, measure net percentage advantage or Alpha Spread from 0% against a compatible peer or index.
captions.ana-micro: Micro & Flow detects volume spikes via 20d Z-Score, spread liquidity dislocation, and the P-06 anomaly score.
captions.ana-engines: The fourth tab is a dynamic ad-hoc tool that varies by asset class: because NVDA is an equity it opens 3D Volatility & Options Payoff, while bonds, FX, and commodities launch their own specialized tools.
captions.res-hero: At the top, Score & Stance summarizes the fundamental verdict, weighted rating, and headline thermometer.
captions.res-rag: In the left column, RAG Document Chat answers verified queries grounded in official SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings.
captions.res-factors: In the center column, the Factors accordion contrasts the top 5 bull drivers against the top 5 bear risks.
captions.res-pulse24h: On the right, FinBERT Pulse scores breaking headlines in real time and plots the 24-hour sentiment curve.
captions.p1-pills: The 6 Summary cards recompute live CAGR, Sharpe and Sortino, 95% VaR, Max Drawdown, Alpha, and diversification.
captions.p1-table: In the Weighting table, add any of the 213 assets, set exact percentage weights, or rebalance to 100%.
captions.p1-xray: Top-right, the 5-tab X-Ray panel audits ETF overlap, exposure, Brinson attribution, cashflow, and custody.
captions.p1-calendar: Below X-Ray, the Monthly Calendar displays January-to-December return consistency and YTD totals.
captions.p1-backtest: And at the full-width bottom, Backtesting compares your portfolio against the S&P 500, 60/40, All-Weather, and Min-Variance.
captions.p2-markowitz: The first quadrant plots the 2D Markowitz Efficient Frontier and positions your portfolio versus Min-Var and Max-Sharpe.
captions.p2-tornado: The bottom-left quadrant tests 5 historical crises, per-asset 95% VaR contribution, and Upside/Downside capture.
captions.p2-corr: Top-right, the 6×6 Matrix compares correlations in normal conditions against crisis tail contagion.
captions.p2-shock2d: Bottom-right, Shock & Markov crosses interest rate shifts with S&P 500 moves and estimates regime transitions.
captions.p2-montecarlo: And the bottom panel projects 10,000 Monte Carlo paths across P95, P50, and P05, underwater Drawdown, and rolling Sharpe.
captions.p3-impact: The 6 Impact cards compare your current portfolio against the projected state after your simulated trades.
captions.p3-whatif: Top-left, What-If & Kelly simulates buy or sell tickets and computes the optimal Half-Kelly position size.
captions.p3-tailhedge: Bottom-left, OTM Put & Margin simulates protective option shields and monitors Reg-T maintenance margin.
captions.p3-committee: In the two right panels, the 3-pillar Committee audits risk guardrails alongside the Execution Log and Copilot.
captions.p3-walkforward: And at the bottom, the Walk-Forward chart validates In-Sample and Out-of-Sample performance with the WFE index.
